title: ATT-06 (#8): extend the existing renderer notification coordinator with canonical scoped material-revision eligibility, replay-safe completion awareness, client-local category/environment-mute/quiet-hour policy, static OS payloads, explicit delivery errors and unavailable click routing. Preserve opt-in modes, legacy fallback only for explicitly unsupported servers, and the existing browser/Electron sound/toast/badge boundary. No server-only sink, native emitter, relay/mobile delivery, preference sync or user-wide lease.
